correctness.rationale: The fourth moment equals the ordered collision sum for pairs with equal first and fourth power sums under counting-to-probability normalization. Using s=a+b and P=ab gives (P-Q)(P+Q-2s^2)=0; at fixed first coordinate t the character sums give w(0)=3q-2+(q-1)chi(-7) and w(t!=0)=3q-3-chi(-7)-2chi(-3), including characteristic 7 where the quadratic degenerates to a linear character sum. Zero-stratum counts yield the complete complex z fourth moment |z|^4+4(q-1)|z|^2+4(q-1)(1+h)Re(z)+(q-1)(3q-8-4h-2k). Descartes sign rule establishes one positive critical radius for h=0 or 1; for h=-1 the radial quotient decreases in |z|^2. Origin-only inputs give quotient 1 and cannot beat maxima. The derivative at constant input has bracket 1+q h+2k, nonzero in allowed characteristics. Independently enumerated complete ordered-pair convolution fibers for prime q=5,7,11,13,17,19,23 and checked both local w(t) and all zero-coordinate collision strata, without using submitted test outputs.
